sourceTitle: History of King Charles the Second of England
description: "History of King Charles the Second of England" by Jacob Abbott is a historical account penned in the mid-19th century. The narrative chronicles the tumultuous life and reign of King Charles II, focusing on his early years, family dynamics, and the broader historical context of his ascension to the throne amid political strife.
